name: Digital Commodities Inc.
summary: Digital Commodities Inc., a Vancouver-based Canadian investment firm, strategically deploys capital across a diverse range of digital and physical non-fiat assets. Its portfolio also includes investments in both private and publicly listed businesses, with a core focus on hard commodities, cryptocurrencies, and the resource sector. The company rebranded to Digital Commodities Inc. in September 2025, having previously operated as Digital Commodities Capital Corp.
